bootstrap: LUMI = LUMI or {} LUMI.slots = LUMI.slots or {} for _, s in pairs(LUMI.slots) do s.id = nil pcall(function() s.bind:set_enabled(false) end) end LUMI.fifo = "/run/user/1000/luminescent/events.fifo" function LUMI.send(msg) hl.exec_cmd("test -p '" .. LUMI.fifo .. "' && printf '%s\\n' '" .. msg .. "' 1<>'" .. LUMI.fifo .. "'") end function LUMI.bind(slot, id, keys, opts) local s = LUMI.slots[slot] if s then s.id = id s.bind:set_enabled(true) return end s = { id = id } s.bind = hl.bind(keys, function() if s.id then LUMI.send(s.id) end end, opts) LUMI.slots[slot] = s end function LUMI.unbind(id) for _, s in pairs(LUMI.slots) do if s.id == id then s.id = nil s.bind:set_enabled(false) end end end function LUMI.unbind_all() for _, s in pairs(LUMI.slots) do if s.id then s.id = nil s.bind:set_enabled(false) end end end if LUMI.rules_version ~= 3 then for _, r in pairs(LUMI.rules or {}) do pcall(function() r:set_enabled(false) end) end LUMI.rules = {} LUMI.rules_version = 3 LUMI.rules[#LUMI.rules + 1] = hl.window_rule({ match = { class = "^luminescent$" }, float = true, pin = true, decorate = false, no_anim = true, no_shadow = true, no_blur = true, no_dim = true, border_size = 0, rounding = 0, opacity = "1 override 1 override" }) LUMI.rules[#LUMI.rules + 1] = hl.window_rule({ match = { class = "^luminescent$", title = "^.*​.*$" }, no_initial_focus = true }) LUMI.rules[#LUMI.rules + 1] = hl.window_rule({ match = { class = "^luminescent$", title = "^.*‌.*$" }, no_initial_focus = true, no_focus = true }) LUMI.rules[#LUMI.rules + 1] = hl.window_rule({ match = { class = "^luminescent$", title = "^.*⁠.*$" }, pin = false }) LUMI.rules[#LUMI.rules + 1] = hl.window_rule({ match = { class = "^luminescent$", title = "^.*⁡.*$" }, no_blur = false }) end

eval LUMI.bind("ALT + Alt_L|1|1", "hk3", "ALT + Alt_L", { description = "Luminescent", release = true, non_consuming = true })

eval LUMI = LUMI or {} if LUMI.glass_rule then pcall(function() LUMI.glass_rule:set_enabled(false) end) end LUMI.glass_rule = hl.window_rule({ match = { class = "^luminescent$", title = "^.*⁢.*$" }, no_blur = false, rounding = 0 })

clear_cover_rules: eval for _, r in pairs((LUMI or {}).cover_rules or {}) do pcall(function() r:set_enabled(false) end) end if LUMI then LUMI.cover_rules = {} end
shutdown_unbind: eval if LUMI and LUMI.unbind_all then LUMI.unbind_all() end
